GitHub. We maintain a [GitHub Lab-repository](https://github.com/PJordano-Lab)
and [Pedro's GitHub repository](https://github.com/pedroj) for code and
projects, as well as [GitHub pages](http://pedroj.github.io/) explaining in
detail different aspects of specific analyses and data resources. In addition to
code, text, and Supplementary Materials associated with specific projects and
manuscripts we maintain the [main datasets](https://github.com/pedroj/datasets),
and specific ones, e.g., [FRUBASE](https://github.com/pedroj/FRUBASE), [network
data](https://github.com/pedroj/datasets_networks) (now in maintenance), etc.
Please read the README files for each repository.
:::

:::: dataset-row
![](static/images/datasets__files__stacks-image-fdcce92.jpg){fig-alt="The FRUBASE database"}

::: dataset-text
![](static/images/datasets__files__stacks-image-9cdc25d.png){.inline-icon} The
[FRUBASE database](http://pedroj.github.io/FRUBASE/). This is the page for the
FRUBASE database, a huge dataset of fleshy fruit traits compiled from
bibliographic references and my own work. Data are provided for more than 1000
plant species from all around the world. The dataset is available [in the Dryad
repository](http://datadryad.org/handle/10255/dryad.46978). Updated versions of
the file as well as supporting code and information are in the [Github
repository](https://github.com/pedroj/FRUBASE).
:::
::::

:::: dataset-row
![](static/images/datasets__files__stacks-image-f3d181a-264x198.jpg){fig-alt="Dataset accompanying Valido A, Schaefer HM, Jordano P (2011) Colour, d"}

::: dataset-text
![](static/images/datasets__files__stacks-image-f89f397.png){.inline-icon}
[Dataset](http://datadryad.org/resource/doi:10.5061/dryad.8011) accompanying
Valido A, Schaefer HM, Jordano P (2011) Colour, design, and reward: phenotypic
integration of fleshy fruit displays. *Journal of Evolutionary Biology* 24(4):
751–760.
[doi:10.1111/j.1420-9101.2010.02206.x](http://dx.doi.org/10.1111/j.1420-9101.2010.02206.x).
Table_S1_Valido etal_Fruit_Integration_DataSet [View File
Details](http://datadryad.org/resource/doi:10.5061/dryad.8011/1). Dataset of
fruit variables (morphology, pulp nutrient, and colour) (see also Appendix S1
for literature sources) and the [full
metadata](http://datadryad.org/resource/doi:10.5061/dryad.8011?show=full) are
also in the Dryad repository.
:::
::::

:::: dataset-row
![](static/images/datasets__files__stacks-image-1609025-216x194.jpg){fig-alt="Dataset accompanying Rezende, E., Lavabre, J., Guimarães Jr., P.R., Jo"}

::: dataset-text
[Dataset](static/pdfs/Rezende_etal_2007_Nature_S1.pdf) accompanying Rezende, E.,
Lavabre, J., Guimarães Jr., P.R., Jordano, P. and Bascompte, J. 2007. Non-random
coextinctions in phylogenetically structured mutualistic networks. *Nature* 448:
925-928. This [.xls file](static/pdfs/Rezende_etal_2007_Nature_S2.xls) includes
the datasets and phylogenies.
:::
::::

:::: dataset-row
![](static/images/datasets__files__stacks-image-2ce20c6-400x300.jpg){fig-alt="The Megafauna fruits dataset"}

::: dataset-text
![](static/images/datasets__files__stacks-image-623feb4.png){.inline-icon} The
[Megafauna fruits dataset](https://github.com/pedroj/megafauna_fruits).
[Dataset](http://www.plosone.org/article/fetchFirstRepresentation.action?uri=info:doi/10.1371/journal.pone.0001745.s001)
accompanying Guimarães Jr, P., Galetti, M. and Jordano, P. 2008. Seed dispersal
anachronisms: rethinking the fruits extinct megafauna ate. [*PLOS One*, 3(3):
e1745](http://www.plosone.org/article/info%3Adoi%2F10.1371%2Fjournal.pone.0001745).
A photo gallery of the megafauna fruits is
[here](gallery.html "Megafauna fruits"). Data available in the [Dryad
repository](http://datadryad.org/handle/10.5061/dryad.bg6fn). Updated versions
of the file as well as supporting code and information are in the [Github
repository](https://github.com/pedroj/megafauna_fruits).
:::
::::

:::: dataset-row
![](static/images/datasets__files__stacks-image-24103f1-528x350.jpg){fig-alt="General methods"}

::: dataset-text
[General methods. Field work](static/pdfs/PrunusDNA_MethodsProtocols.pdf).
*Prunus mahaleb* seed dispersal ecology. This document describes our general
approach to the study of seed dispersal ecology with *Prunus mahaleb*. It
includes a description of both field methods and lab methods.
:::
::::

:::: dataset-row
![](static/images/datasets__files__stacks-image-7de89e7-150x150.jpg){fig-alt="Lab methods and protocols"}

::: dataset-text

describes the specific lab protocols. Updated versions of the file as well as
supporting code and information are in the [Github
repository](https://github.com/pedroj/Prunus-protocols).
:::
